summary: The prepared base reproduces the original cumsum(None) failure. The exact candidate derives consistent DCP target-verify prefix and extend geometry and fixes both the original crash and the reviewed expanded-host-length fallback counterexample.

tests.what_was_measured: On recorded base, the actual imported DCP planner raised TypeError at torch.cumsum when extend_prefix_lens was None.
Candidate regression suite: 5 passed, including its ROCm CUDA-device parameter and missing-live-host-length counterexample.

Independent gfx950 multi-request case: committed prefixes [0,8,15], expanded host totals [7,15,22], normalized CPU/GPU prefixes [0,8,15], extend [7,7,7], total 44, planner buffer [44,1], prefix sum 23; ordinary extend metadata passed through unchanged.
Nearby DCP layout and DSpark ragged verification coverage: 27 tests and 18 subtests passed.
All applicable focused static and registration checks passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 used one AMD Instinct MI350X with capability (9,5)/gfx950. Candidate helper arithmetic and DCP planner tensor allocation ran on that device; index-generation kernels were no-op test doubles.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, not the reported two-node eight-B300-per-side deployment.
Mooncake PD transport, TP/EP/DCP size 8, full Kimi K3 serving, multi-node behavior, and semantic accuracy were not exercised.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable; planner index-generation kernels were replaced by no-op test doubles in the isolated GPU check.
